t: Chisel-Strike Refactoring: Nix Flake for Jupyter Notebooks and AI Collaboration Lessons
s: This article details a practical refactoring of a Nix Flake configuration to manage Jupyter notebooks, emphasizing a 'chisel-strike' approach for safe, iterative development. It also touches upon AI-human collaboration and context management.
sub: Nix Flake refactoring for Jupyter notebooks
